note: Recast from Sjöstedt 1925; the original is in German and describes the major soldier only.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: frons with a distinct short median carina behind; antenna 17 segments. Measurements (mm): head length (with mandibles) 5.31; head width 3. Similar to Odontotermes monodon, but the head is narrower and more rectangular.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality: Amani, Usambara Mountains, Tanzania; type specimens in the Stockholm Museum.
